A TOTAL SCAM during their 2025 Memorial Day 40% off sale at this yard. They tried to charge me for a different item in a similar category that is significantly more expensive to make up the difference if not more. Tried charging me for a large touch display for $59.99 instead of a $42.99 Radio with built-in Touchscreen. Also wanted to charge for all the cut wires attached to the radio as a "Pigtail" for each one. Also, the same thing with a Control Module, a different item that was significantly higher in price with those cut wires being charged as "Pigtails" as well. I left everything on the counter and walked out. NEVER AGAIN will I go to a % off everything sale. This place has become a downhill greedy expensive place to get used car parts now.
